title: A Collection of Question Answering Datasets for Norwegian
findings: The paper does not report findings specific to the religion category. The general finding for the NorTruthfulQA dataset, which includes questions on religion, is that language models are 'likely to repeat human falsehoods' and tend to generate answers that convey false beliefs or misconceptions.
